title: GRANULAR (Digitone insert)
author: analoglav
description: Stereo granular insert, two overlapping grains for each of two independently MIDI-selectable pitch voices. Pitch A CC33 / Pitch B CC34: eight equal 16-CC bands (-12,-7,-5,0,+5,+7,+12,+24 semitones); defaults +5/+12. Grain size CC36: 40-140ms in 2ms steps, 100ms default (CC value 76). CC60 dry/wet. All CC on AUTO channel while GRANULAR enabled. Parameter changes latch on the next grain boundary. No custom delay/reverb. Original Digitone synth/FX are preserved upstream; fixed-point DSP with a 128KiB history ring.
